evidence_notes: Bulbapedia release info: regular 28/83 = Naoki Saito; the Full Art print (The Best of XY 173/171) is new artwork by Ryo Ueda and was released in English as Yellow A Alternate 28a/83. TCGdex's own xya-28a record independently reads Ryo Ueda, contradicting its g1-28a record.
Bulbapedia release info: Generations 73/83 = Yusuke Ohmura; The Best of XY Full Art 186/171 is new artwork by Naoki Saito, released as Yellow A Alternate 73a/83 based on the Generations print.
Distinct GX Battle Boost source artwork included in the Guzzlord-GX Box (2018-01-05); illustrator genuinely unchanged at 5ban Graphics across all listed printings.
Bulbapedia states the Fates Collide Full Art print is new artwork by the same artist as 105 (Megumi Mizutani). Distinct artwork, same illustrator.

Bulbapedia release info credits the Yellow A Alternate 111a/124 Full Art to Naoki Saito, distinct from Ken Sugimori's XY 127 / FCO 111 art. SOURCE CONFLICT: limitlesstcg.com/cards/fco/111a reads Ken Sugimori - see report section 8; Limitless reproduces the same base-illustrator defect on other rows and is treated as a derived feed, not an independent source.
Bulbapedia release info: regular 43/124 = PLANETA (PLANETA Otani per Trivia); the Full Art print released as Yellow A Alternate 43a/124 is credited to Ryo Ueda.

Bulbapedia: 54a is a Full Art card with NEW artwork by 5ban Graphics (Mega Powers Collection, 2017-05-19). The separate XY151 promo is Eske Yoshinob, but that is a different card id and out of scope. TCGdex xya-54a agrees.
Bulbapedia: The Best of XY Full Art 182/171 is new artwork by the same artist; every listed printing including 88a/106 credits Masakazu Fukuda.
Bulbapedia: Full Art 55a/111 (Mega Powers Collection, 2017-05-19) credited to 5ban Graphics, same as regular and secret prints. TCGdex xya-55a agrees.
Bulbapedia: all printings including Yellow A Alternate 24a/119 credit 5ban Graphics. TCGdex xya-24a agrees.
Bulbapedia release info: regular 65/119 = Ayaka Yoshida; the Yellow A Alternate 65a/119 Full Art is explicitly new artwork by Ryo Ueda (Premium Trainer's XY Collection, 2017-10-20).

Bulbapedia release info: regular 77/108 = Ayaka Yoshida; ROS Full Art 106/108 = Ryo Ueda; The Best of XY Full Art 188/171 = TOKIYA (depicts Mega Rayquaza alongside Shaymin) and that is the print released as Yellow A Alternate 77a/108.
Bulbapedia: Yellow A Alternate 92a/108 is a new print with different artwork by the same artist (Battle Arena Decks). Distinct artwork, illustrator genuinely Toyste Beach. TCGdex xya-92a agrees.
Bulbapedia release info: regular 75/98 = Yusuke Ohmura; The Best of XY Full Art 181/171 = You Iribi, reprinted in English as Yellow A Alternate 75a/98 (Premium Trainer's XY Collection, 2017-10-20).

Bulbapedia release info: BREAKpoint 107/122 = Yusuke Ohmura; the 107a Yellow A Alternate variant is credited to Naoki Saito. TCGdex's own xya-107a record independently reads Naoki Saito, contradicting its xy9-107a record.

Bulbapedia distinguishes all three prints: 98 = Yusuke Ohmura; 98a (Battle Arena Decks) = Megumi Mizutani; 98b (Premium Trainer's XY Collection) = Sanosuke Sakuma. This also independently validates ATTR-0's R2 classification of xy9-98a.
Bulbapedia release info: XY150 (Shiny Kalos Tins) = Eske Yoshinob; XY150a Yellow A Alternate Full Art = Hasuno, depicting Xerneas alongside Yveltal (Premium Trainer's XY Collection, 2017-10-20).
Bulbapedia release info: XY177 regular = You Iribi; XY177a Full Art (The Best of XY 183/171) = Hitoshi Ariga, released in English as a Yellow A Alternate card.
Bulbapedia: both XY198 and the XY198a Full Art (The Best of XY, then Premium Trainer's XY Collection) credit 5ban Graphics.
Bulbapedia: both XY200 and the XY200a Full Art (The Best of XY, then Premium Trainer's XY Collection) credit 5ban Graphics.
